name: Nova X1 5G
description: Nova X1 5G is an affordable AI-powered smartphone designed for college students and young professionals. It offers an AI personal assistant for daily tasks and study support, AI camera enhancement for better photographs, intelligent battery optimisation, smooth multitasking and a simple user interface. The device focuses on delivering useful smart features at an affordable price of ₹19,999.

features.name: AI Personal Assistant
features.explanation: Daily tasks, study reminders, and smart notifications.

features.name: AI Camera Enhancement
features.explanation: Automated low-light and portrait enhancement for photos and reels.

features.name: Smart Battery Optimisation
features.explanation: Adapts power consumption to daily routine usage patterns.

features.name: On-Device AI Processing
features.explanation: Selected AI tasks run locally on-device for enhanced personal privacy.

features.name: Smooth Performance
features.explanation: High refresh display and fast processor for multitasking and casual gaming.

features.name: Simple Interface
features.explanation: Clean layout with optional contextual AI suggestions.
